displayName: OCI-AI-PD-010: AI — Model DoS via Resource Exhaustion
description:
Detects denial-of-service attacks against AI models through excessive token consumption or compute exhaustion

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: ai — model dos via resource exhaustion

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_pd_010", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%model%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%dos%') AND "value" > 0
